HOW TO USE IT
Mix builder
Layer up to three sounds and balance each one to taste.
Tap sounds in the Library to add them, then drag their sliders in the mix panel.
Timer & fades
The sleep timer fades your mix out at the end, and fade-in eases it on at the start.
Tap the timer button in the player to pick a duration; set default fade lengths in Settings.
Night lock
Blocks accidental taps so a stray hand can\'t stop your sound.
Turn it on at the bottom of the player, then long-press the screen to unlock.
Presets
Saves a finished mix so you can start it again with one tap.
Tap the save button in the player, then find, pin or reorder it on the Presets tab.
Wind-down reminder
A nightly notification nudges you to start winding down.
Enable it in Settings and choose the hour and minute you want the nudge.
Tinnitus sounds
Noise tuned to a frequency helps mask ringing in the ears.
Open the Tinnitus category in the Library and pick the pitch closest to your ring.
Bluetooth behaviour
Playback pauses by itself when your headphones disconnect.
Reconnect and press play; a BT badge on Home shows when headphones are linked.
